changeSet.author: fineract
changeSet.comment:
Which entity a command acts on and what it does to it, in the vocabulary of m_permission. Without them a command record cannot be found by an audit search or a checker inbox, both of which are defined in terms of these two names, and the permission governing maker-checker approval - the action and entity joined with _CHECKER - cannot be derived. The approval columns are already on this table; this is what they need to become usable.
Not null, because a row without them is invisible to everything that reads this table by name. Rows that predate this column are backfilled as UNKNOWN: they were written before commands recorded it, and saying so is better than implying they acted on an entity called "".
